Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on an untagged COSE_Sign1 structure with attached payload. Apart from the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain, the implementation shall add one counter signature of the signature as the only element of the uHeaders unprotected header parameter. The counter signature shall be a full (non abbreviated) version 2 counter signature as specified in IETF RFC 9338 (COSE_Countersignature, label 11), untagged, incorporated as an element of the uHeaders unprotected header parameter of the counter-signed signature (clause 5.1.6). The counter signature shall itself contain at least the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain (identifying the counter-signer certificate) and shall not contain the content type header parameter, as its payload is a signature (clause 5.1.3). Its signature value shall be computed as specified in clause 3.3 of IETF RFC 9338, with context string "CounterSignature". The counter-signed structure in the Countersign_structure is the COSE_Sign1 structure, so the other_fields array shall contain its signature value. No other optional component shall be present. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
